title: George E NDE 6192
content: The moment I lost consciousness, I found myself in an unknown dimension, one that opposes the material world we live down here on planet Earth. Comparatively, it looks pretty much like the obscure side of the two sides of the same coin. In a matter of a couple of seconds, my body just snapped and I lost consciousness. The next moment, I was being gently channeled towards an incredibly bright, white light. The light had a brilliance that didn't hurt my eyes. Its attraction was so powerful, like a huge magnet that was the size of the entire Universe. It was totally irresistible. I was hovering and able to move in any direction that I wanted to move my body (or my mind, I should say) and it seemed to me that I was under no restriction; that I could fly away anywhere I wished to throughout that dimension. My mind was at my will and my will was my mind. I was completely aware that I was within the boundaries of what true life really is - a spiritual, mindful, non-dimensional world at the disposal of my consciousness. So I decided to go on a brief tour and discover the secrets of this unknown world. I was shown colors - incredibly beautiful - but which I just can't describe because I have no words to classify them, and neither do I know of any similar colors. With excitement, I was looking to find other secrets, when a friendly 'voice' told me that I couldn't stay because 'it was not my time yet' and I had a mission on earth waiting to be accomplished. I had to return to this current earth life of mine. I didn't want to return and leave behind that amazing world that I had just encountered, but without any bargaining taking place, my will just didn't prevail, and I was back in my aching body, laying down in bed after the physical stress I went through.

arrival.other_being_detail: A friendly 'voice' told him he couldn't stay because it was not his time yet and he had a mission on earth.

environment.environment_other_detail: An 'unknown dimension' opposing the material world; described as like the obscure side of a two-sided coin; colors 'incredibly beautiful' but indescribable.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he had "a mission on earth waiting to be accomplished."

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He reports immediately being in an unknown dimension, then being gently channeled toward a bright white light, exploring the realm/colors, then being told to return and returning to his body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Describes the realm as an 'unknown dimension' opposing the material world, like the obscure side of a two-sided coin; emphasizes will/mind control ('My mind was at my will and my will was my mind').
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "being gently channeled towards an incredibly bright, white light"; "it was not my time yet"; "I had a mission on earth waiting to be accomplished."
